subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick demo & scheduler
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps & quick demo link

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for signing up for a trial of Redwood! We’ve provisioned a developer sandbox for you; you should have received credentials and a short onboarding note in the console. A couple quick next steps you can take right away: 

- Explore the quickstart notebook in your sandbox (Console -> Quickstart).
- Try generating a short sample with the “developer-demo” model to check latency in your region.
- If you’d like a guided walkthrough, I’m happy to book a 30-minute session to cover model selection, integration patterns, and cost controls.

If you want a walkthrough, reply to this thread or pick a time on Connor’s calendar here: https://redwood-inference.com/s/connor/booking/abc123

Attached: Redwood-OnePager.pdf (one-page overview)

Welcome aboard,
Monica Patel
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Thanks, Monica — appreciate the quick start.

I’m Sarah Lin, Product Lead at Acme Analytics. We started a small self-serve trial to validate a proof-of-concept for a document-search feature. Would love a short walkthrough focused on: indexing best practices, embedding costs, and latency tuning.

I’m based in PST — best windows next week are Tue/Thu mornings (9–11am PT). 30 minutes should do it.

Also curious whether you have any brief engineering prep or checklist we should review before the call.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Product Lead — Acme Analytics
sarah.lin@acmeanalytics.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Great to meet you (virtually). I’m Connor, on the SDR/solutions side — happy to run the walkthrough and bring an engineer if we want to deep-dive.

Here are three 30-minute windows that match your Tue/Thu mornings preference (all PT):
- Tue 10/16 — 9:30–10:00am PT
- Thu 10/18 — 10:00–10:30am PT
- Tue 10/23 — 9:00–9:30am PT

If none of these work, you can pick any open slot on my calendar: https://redwood-inference.com/s/connor/booking/abc123

Thanks Sarah — slot confirmed. I just sent the Google Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234@google.com (Thu, Oct 18, 2028 — 10:00–10:30am PT). Please accept and add Mark.

Sample dataset: we usually use the "Acme Docs Sample" (public anonymized set) — link here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PrepDocID/view?usp=sharing. It’s small and mirrors typical doc-search layouts.

Joining details: I’ll invite one of our engineers (Tessa) to the calendar so she can show embedding and indexing choices during the call. If you want us to run any one-off ingest beforehand, drop me a sample file and we’ll ingest it into your sandbox.

See you on Thu — feel free to reply with any changes or if you want a 45-minute slot instead.
